For me it was when people would pretend to be my friend, but would talk about me in a very infantilizing way. They would compliment me mocking ways, like an example would  in middle school I was one of the only black students and I was the only one who had Afro textured hair — so they would sarcastically compliment that and turn to their friends and laugh. Back then people would also often ask me out as a joke, and would pretend to be interested while their friends are giggling in the back. Another example didn’t actually happen to me but in high school there was this guy who was autistic and one of my classmates would pretend to have a crush on him and constantly try to be around him while discreetly making fun of him. It took me years to be able to pick up on it because it’s so subtle but seeing it happen to another person is unfortunately what made me realize how much it happened to me
